B1.name: Flash Rejuvenate
B1.description: Carla slices the air to create lightning that she controls, its diverse intensity able to harm and heal, having [Wind] element.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Claps lightning between her hands and heals the ally with the lowest health by % of her own max health. Attacks opponents in the blast for that amount of health amount as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Clutch a lightning orb and release it forward rapidly, becoming able to absorb and reflect a single incoming attack for its duration. This can also work with AoE attacks.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Directs a surge of lightning around her that inflicts [Knockback], damaging and converting x random debuff on self or allies into an applicable buff. Hit opponents are dealt damage equal to % of her health. Skill upgrades can increase the debuff conversion number by a percentage, acting as a percentage rate.

additional.text: <u>Applicable Buff</u>: Any debuff that reduces a certain stat or modifier (element resistance) will be converted to their reciprocal at the same value and duration. Drain debuffs remain the same but also reversed in effect.
{{effect:knockback}}

S1.name: One-Tap Megavolt
S1.description: Become still and summon a sphere of electricity that has a stability meter which records the amount of absorbed elemental attacks from opponents. Can take a bulk amount before being destroyed. Opponents nearby will take [Knockback]. Most enemies will prioritize attacking the sphere with elemental attacks.

additional.text: When the electric sphere is on-field, this skill button can be spammed to raise its charge meter. When the charge meter is filled, the electric sphere will implode and send a shockwave that reduces self, allies, and all opponents’ health within a medium range, dealing 2 instances of [Wind] super empowered damage.

The amount of damage per target per hit is equal to % of Carla’s max health, being able to reduce at max 90% of a target character’s health. The damage is tripled on bosses. After 4 seconds, if any character has buffs, they immediately recover their lost health.
{{effect:knockback}}
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Mana Cost: 180 MP
Energy Gauge: 20% to detonate

S2.name: Electrostatic Engage
S2.description: A wave of electricity is expanded outward around Carla, inflicting the [Freeze] debuff on opponents in range. The wave inflicts an effect that transfers buffs from them to self. The amount of buffs is dependent on their debuff resistance. Up to x of 5 buffs can be transferred (above 100% increases the number of buffs even more).

additional.text: The buffs transferred go in a time-frozen state in which they do not activate nor tick down their duration. Stolen [Shield] and the related will take effect and will not be time-frozen. Each buff gained on self will heal self and allies by % of her max health.
{{effect:freeze}}
{{effect:shield}}
Cooldown: 11 seconds per charge
Mana Cost: 250 MP

U1.name: Electrostasis Pulse
U1.description: Kiara gathers lightning into her palm and lets it free to implode the space around her.

additional.text: The lightning will send a high current in a wide AoE, dealing % of attack as [Wind] damage.
If she has an active power meter, consumes 9 points and the AoE is increased further and, upon use, gains 30% of energy gauge back.
Energy Gauge: 100%

T1.name: Black Rampart
T1.description: When Carla heals and the entire team is at max health, fill a health meter with the excess health points. All Black Rampart members that have [Surge] will have every stat scaled and increased by +0.005% for each point of additional health in the health meter. Excess health will be depleted before regular health when taking damage and is shared between all characters in the party. The health meter stays indefinitely.

additional.text: Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: Kiara’s movement speed is inversely related to her health where every 1% of health missing from max will increase her movement speed by +1%. Skill damage will increase by each percentage of crit rate over 100% at a 1-to-1 rate. Whenever Kiara damages an opponent with an uninfused skill, she applies [Claw Mark] effect on them.

additional.text: {{effect:claw-mark}}
When the party consists only of [Wind] and [Water] elements, the opponent’s resistance to those elements are reduced by -25% within battle proximity.
Every 200 points of attack stat Kiara has will increase her crit rate by +1%. Her piercing stat increases by +1% for every 5% of crit rate.

The power meter from Special Skill: Lightning God Mode will start with 150 points. Each point missing from the meter when a Basic Skill is used will increase damage by +1%. Her attack speed increases by +0.2% per point on the meter.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.
Opponent’s resistance to [Wind] and [Water] elements are further reduced by an additional -25% for the party consisting of only those affinities.

Extra Life: When Kiara would be defeated by a lethal attack, she gains immunity and restores 9% of her health. She additionally gains the effect [Invincibility]. This effect occurs only once per battle.
{{effect:invincibility}}
Increase [Lightning Element] damage for self and allies by +40%.

The Technical Skill: Lightning Discharge is improved: Having [Lightning Element] aura and next damaged by [Water] attacks will increase the instance of hits by +1 for each party member of the inflictor with an element aura on themselves on the battlefield (each element and person is counted once). Having [Water] aura and being hit by [Lightning Element] attack will increase instances based on Kiara’s power meter where every 10 points missing increases the hit instance by +1.
